description.en: Integrated Procurement is the corporate procurement platform for PT Saptaindra Sejati / Alamtri. It unifies vendor qualification, proposal tracking, Term Sheet and contract drafting, and contract monitoring in one permission-driven workspace for internal staff — available as a full Suite or as dedicated module portals (Vendor Onboarding, Proposal Tracker, Contract Monitoring) — with an invite-only Vendor Workspace for vendor PICs. Term Sheet, Letter of Award, and Contract run inside Proposal Tracker.
description.id: Integrated Procurement adalah platform pengadaan korporat untuk PT Saptaindra Sejati / Alamtri. Platform ini menyatukan kualifikasi vendor, pelacakan proposal, penyusunan Term Sheet dan kontrak, serta monitoring kontrak dalam satu ruang kerja berbasis permission untuk staf internal — tersedia sebagai Suite lengkap atau portal modul terpisah (Vendor Onboarding, Proposal Tracker, Contract Monitoring) — serta Vendor Workspace khusus undangan untuk PIC vendor. Term Sheet, Letter of Award, dan Contract berjalan di dalam Proposal Tracker.

items.en: Invite-only portal for vendor PICs
items.id: Portal khusus undangan untuk PIC vendor

items.en: Five-step registration wizard (Agreement, Bio Data, General/Specific Requirements, Portfolio)
items.id: Wizard registrasi 5 langkah (Agreement, Bio Data, Persyaratan Umum/Khusus, Portfolio)

items.en: Direct-to-Blob document upload with progress (short-lived write SAS); Development stores files on local disk
items.id: Unggah dokumen langsung ke Blob dengan progres (write SAS berumur pendek); Development menyimpan file di disk lokal

items.en: Vendor logo on the profile hero; e-certificate visible after the vendor is registered
items.id: Logo vendor di hero profil; e-sertifikat tampil setelah vendor terdaftar

items.en: Internal vendor registry, dossier, invitations, contacts, and approval queue
items.id: Registri vendor internal, dossier, undangan, kontak, dan antrian persetujuan

items.en: Approval follows Master Data ▸ Vendor Status (Submitted → Department Head → Division Head → Approved → Registered) with working-day SLA
items.id: Persetujuan mengikuti Master Data ▸ Status Vendor (Submitted → Department Head → Division Head → Approved → Registered) dengan SLA hari kerja

items.en: E-certificate issuance (QR PDF) and public verification
items.id: Penerbitan e-sertifikat (PDF QR) dan verifikasi publik

items.en: Create-only import from Ariba workbooks and from Vendor Connect, including document copy into Blob
items.id: Impor create-only dari workbook Ariba dan dari Vendor Connect, termasuk salin dokumen ke Blob

items.en: Lifecycle PROP → TIA → RFQ → NEGO → EVAL → TERM, then LOA in parallel with Contract
items.id: Siklus PROP → TIA → RFQ → NEGO → EVAL → TERM, lalu LOA paralel dengan Contract

items.en: Term Sheet, Letter of Award, and Contract run per winner from the Proposals matrix (step popups and Proposal Profile)
items.id: Term Sheet, Letter of Award, dan Contract berjalan per pemenang dari matriks Proposals (popup step dan Proposal Profile)

items.en: Working-day SLA plan per method, overdue monitoring, and distribution to officers
items.id: Rencana SLA hari kerja per metode, pemantauan overdue, dan distribusi ke officer

items.en: Award result from Bid Evaluation (Tender/Pemilihan) or Negotiation (Penunjukan); completing Term Sheet opens LOA and Contract together — they stay locked until then
items.id: Hasil award dari Bid Evaluation (Tender/Pemilihan) atau Negotiation (Penunjukan); menyelesaikan Term Sheet membuka LOA dan Contract bersamaan — keduanya tetap terkunci sampai saat itu

items.en: Assigned officers generate Term Sheet from the award result
items.id: Officer yang ditunjuk generate Term Sheet dari hasil award

items.en: Manual E-Proposal sync for Super Admin / Administrator and Section Head Tracker
items.id: Sinkronisasi E-Proposal manual untuk Super Admin / Administrator dan Section Head Tracker

items.en: Available in Proposal Tracker (Suite path /proposal-tracker/… and the Tracker module portal)
items.id: Tersedia di Proposal Tracker (path Suite /proposal-tracker/… dan portal modul Tracker)

items.en: Term Sheet from Tracker award results (one case per winner); Generate is officer-only
items.id: Term Sheet dari hasil award Tracker (satu kasus per pemenang); Generate hanya untuk officer

items.en: Contract drafting from Word templates; Document Repository for LOA, Term Sheet, draft, and final
items.id: Penyusunan kontrak dari template Word; Repositori Dokumen untuk LOA, Term Sheet, draf, dan final

items.en: Letter of Award generated after that winner’s Term Sheet is complete
items.id: Letter of Award dibuat setelah Term Sheet pemenang tersebut selesai

items.en: Signed-contract registry and version history
items.id: Registri kontrak tertandatangani dan riwayat versi

items.en: Tiered expiry reminders (template-driven) with a sent-mail log
items.id: Pengingat jatuh tempo bertingkat (berbasis template) dengan log email terkirim

items.en: Excel / SharePoint contract import and List of Material sync (background import queue)
items.id: Impor kontrak Excel / SharePoint dan sinkronisasi Daftar Material (antrean impor di latar)

items.en: Permission-driven RBAC (roles as bundles; per-screen master-data keys)
items.id: RBAC berbasis permission (peran sebagai kumpulan izin; kunci master data per layar)

items.en: Master data, menu tree, bilingual languages, holiday calendar, and Super Admin ▸ Background processes
items.id: Master data, pohon menu, bahasa bilingual, kalender hari libur, dan Super Admin ▸ Proses latar

items.en: Admin-editable email templates (branded HTML wrapper), settings, notifications, and audit trail
items.id: Template email yang dapat diedit admin (bungkus HTML bermerek), pengaturan, notifikasi, dan jejak audit

features.en: Permission is the single authorization primitive — menus, APIs, and UI all gate on moduleKey.action keys; a role is a bundle of permissions.
features.id: Permission adalah primitif otorisasi tunggal — menu, API, dan UI semuanya dibatasi oleh kunci moduleKey.action; peran adalah kumpulan permission.

features.en: Internal staff sign in with SISWarrior SSO (NRP). There is no local internal password; complexity and lockout policy apply to vendor accounts only. Development keeps a passwordless NRP dev-login.
features.id: Staf internal masuk dengan SSO SISWarrior (NRP). Tidak ada kata sandi lokal internal; kebijakan kompleksitas dan lockout hanya berlaku untuk akun vendor. Development tetap punya dev-login NRP tanpa kata sandi.

features.en: Vendor PICs use invite-only local accounts. Password complexity and lockout follow Super Admin ▸ Settings ▸ Security.
features.id: PIC vendor memakai akun lokal khusus undangan. Kompleksitas kata sandi dan lockout mengikuti Super Admin ▸ Settings ▸ Security.

features.en: Staff can work from the full Suite or from a dedicated module portal (Vendor Onboarding, Proposal Tracker, Contract Monitoring). Each portal reverse-proxies only its own APIs; Tracker also proxies Term Sheet APIs.
features.id: Staf dapat bekerja dari Suite lengkap atau dari portal modul terpisah (Vendor Onboarding, Proposal Tracker, Contract Monitoring). Setiap portal hanya mem-proxy API miliknya; Tracker juga mem-proxy API Term Sheet.

features.en: Backend is the source of truth for email send/log, master/seed data, and document storage (Azure Blob with short-lived SAS URLs; Development uploads stay on local disk).
features.id: Backend adalah sumber kebenaran untuk pengiriman/log email, data master/seed, dan penyimpanan dokumen (Azure Blob dengan SAS URL berumur pendek; unggahan Development tetap di disk lokal).

features.en: Modular monolith Clean Architecture: modules do not reference each other's Infrastructure; cross-module reads go through Application ports.
features.id: Modular monolith Clean Architecture: modul tidak mereferensikan Infrastructure modul lain; pembacaan lintas modul melalui port Application.

features.en: Dates are stored in UTC and displayed in Asia/Jakarta (WIB). Working-day SLA uses Saturday/Sunday plus the holiday master calendar.
features.id: Tanggal disimpan dalam UTC dan ditampilkan dalam zona Asia/Jakarta (WIB). SLA hari kerja memakai Sabtu/Minggu plus kalender master hari libur.

features.en: The interface is bilingual (English / Bahasa Indonesia), including this About dialog.
features.id: Antarmuka bilingual (English / Bahasa Indonesia), termasuk dialog About ini.

items.en: First production release of Integrated Procurement — a .NET 10 modular monolith with a Vite-built React frontend (Suite, three module portals, and Vendor Workspace).
items.id: Rilis produksi pertama Integrated Procurement — modular monolith .NET 10 dengan frontend React yang dibangun Vite (Suite, tiga portal modul, dan Vendor Workspace).

items.en: Vendor Workspace: invite-only PIC portal, five-step registration wizard, direct-to-Blob document upload, vendor logo on the profile, and e-certificate after registration.
items.id: Vendor Workspace: portal PIC khusus undangan, wizard registrasi 5 langkah, unggah dokumen langsung ke Blob, logo vendor di profil, dan e-sertifikat setelah terdaftar.

items.en: Vendor Onboarding: registry, invitations, contacts, Vendor Status approval chain with working-day SLA, e-certificate (QR PDF) plus public verification, and create-only import from Ariba and Vendor Connect (including document copy).
items.id: Vendor Onboarding: registri, undangan, kontak, rantai persetujuan Status Vendor dengan SLA hari kerja, e-sertifikat (PDF QR) plus verifikasi publik, dan impor create-only dari Ariba serta Vendor Connect (termasuk salin dokumen).

items.en: Proposal Tracker: PROP → TIA → RFQ → NEGO → EVAL → TERM, then Letter of Award in parallel with Contract; per-winner Term Sheet / LOA / Contract from the Proposals matrix; working-day SLA and overdue monitoring.
items.id: Proposal Tracker: PROP → TIA → RFQ → NEGO → EVAL → TERM, lalu Letter of Award paralel dengan Contract; Term Sheet / LOA / Contract per pemenang dari matriks Proposals; SLA hari kerja dan pemantauan overdue.

items.en: Term Sheet from Tracker award (one case per winner, officer-only generate), Word-template contracts, Document Repository; completing Term Sheet opens LOA and Contract together.
items.id: Term Sheet dari award Tracker (satu kasus per pemenang, generate hanya officer), kontrak dari template Word, Repositori Dokumen; menyelesaikan Term Sheet membuka LOA dan Contract bersamaan.

items.en: Contract Monitoring: signed-contract registry, tiered expiry reminders, Excel/SharePoint import, and List of Material sync.
items.id: Contract Monitoring: registri kontrak tertandatangani, pengingat jatuh tempo bertingkat, impor Excel/SharePoint, dan sinkronisasi Daftar Material.

items.en: Platform: permission-driven RBAC, master data, bilingual UI, SISWarrior SSO for internal staff, vendor-only password policy, branded HTML email templates, Super Admin background processes, notifications, and audit.
items.id: Platform: RBAC berbasis permission, master data, UI bilingual, SSO SISWarrior untuk staf internal, kebijakan kata sandi khusus vendor, template email HTML bermerek, proses latar Super Admin, notifikasi, dan audit.

items.en: Hosting: Suite on Azure App Service contractone, Vendor Workspace on vendor-workspace, and module portals vendor-onboarding, proposal-tracker, and contract-monitoring; GitHub Actions deploy to staging and production slots.
items.id: Hosting: Suite di Azure App Service contractone, Vendor Workspace di vendor-workspace, dan portal modul vendor-onboarding, proposal-tracker, serta contract-monitoring; GitHub Actions men-deploy ke slot staging dan production.

specifications.value: SISWarrior SSO (NRP); no local password. Development: passwordless /auth/dev-login
ASP.NET Core Identity (cookie, invite-only); password + lockout policy
Azure Blob Storage (short-lived SAS); Development uses local disk
Azure App Service contractone (API + SPA wwwroot; production + staging slot)
Azure App Services vendor-onboarding, proposal-tracker, contract-monitoring (ModuleGateway + SPA; production + staging slot)
Azure App Service vendor-workspace (https://vendor-workspace.azurewebsites.net; production + staging slot)
ModuleGateway → platform paths + one business prefix (Tracker also proxies Term Sheet APIs). Other modules and vendor portal → 404
GitHub Actions — Deploy Internal; Deploy Vendor; Deploy Module Portals
